Body.Content: Azure Domain Name System (DNS) allows you to host your domains with your Azure apps. By hosting your domains in Azure, you can manage your DNS records by using your existing Azure subscription. The global Microsoft network of servers has the reach, scale, and redundancy needed to ensure ultra-fast DNS responses and ultra-high availability for your domains. For more information, please visit the Azure DNS page. For the pricing information, please visit the Azure DNS pricing page.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Domain Name System (DNS) allows you to host your domains with your Azure apps. By hosting your domains in Azure, you can manage your DNS records by using your existing Azure subscription. The global Microsoft network of servers has the reach, scale, and redundancy needed to ensure ultra-fast DNS responses and ultra-high availability for your domains.

For more information, please visit the Azure DNS page. For the pricing information, please visit the Azure DNS pricing page.
